title: upload-artifact v4 fails with 409 Conflict when matrix jobs upload to the same artifact name
symptoms: Failed to CreateArtifact: Received non-retryable error: Failed request: (409) Conflict: an artifact with this name already exists on the workflow run
Matrix jobs that shared one artifact in v3 fail after a Dependabot bump
Only the first job's upload succeeds
cause: Artifacts created by upload-artifact v4 are immutable, so two jobs cannot write to the same name. v3 allowed it and merged the files.
fix: Give each job a unique artifact name and merge them with download-artifact using a pattern.
apply:
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: results-${{ matrix.os }}
    path: out/
# later job
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
  with:
    pattern: results-*
    merge-multiple: true
